name: Salungano Group Limited
summary: Salungano Group Limited, incorporated in 2005 and headquartered in Sandton, South Africa, is primarily focused on the thermal coal industry. This entity, which was formerly known as Wescoal Holdings Limited until its name change in April 2022, is engaged in the entire value chain of thermal coal, encompassing its extraction, processing, marketing, and distribution, with a principal focus on the South African market. Its business operations are divided into four core segments: Mining, Trading, Property Rental, and Investment Holding. The company undertakes the exploration, beneficiation, and mining of bituminous coal, subsequently supplying it to customers within the country. Key mining assets include the Elandspruit, Khanyisa Complex, and Vanggatfontein Collieries, complemented by interests in the Moabsvelden and Arnot projects. Furthermore, Salungano Group Limited diversifies its activities through property leasing. The company operates as a subsidiary of K2016316243 (SA) Proprietary Limited.
